EXT.evidence: Initiates and narrates a playful social activity with another person (“planning to blow a bubble… about to begin”) and stays engaged throughout.

AGR.evidence: Works cooperatively (“we are back on track”) and explicitly acknowledges help (“Speaker_01 just helped TargetSpeaker”).

CON.evidence: Impulsive/careless behavior—chews someone else’s gum and ends up choking.

NEU.evidence: States the situation is OK and shows no expressed anxiety even when choking; responds matter‑of‑factly and accepts help.

OPN.evidence: Willing to try a novel, impish act (blowing a bubble with someone else’s gum).
